jobs.title: Principal Fire Engineer
jobs.description: Company Overview Throughout our worldwide network of experts, clients and communities, we are renowned for our leadership in fire protection engineering – a legacy of responsibility we have proudly upheld since 1939. Today, our expertise extends broadly across closely related security and risk-based fields – from accessibility consulting and risk analysis to process safety, forensic investigations, security risk consulting, emergency management, digital innovation and more. Our engineers and consultants collaborate to solve complex safety and security challenges, ensuring our clients can protect what matters most. For over 80 years, we have helped mitigate risks that threaten lives, property and reputations. Through technology, expertise and industry-leading research, we remain dedicated to our purpose of making our world safe, secure and resilient. At Jensen Hughes, we believe that creating and sustaining a culture of trust, integrity and professional growth starts with putting our people first. Our employees are our greatest strength, and we value the unique perspectives and talents they bring to our organization. Our wide range of Global Employee Networks connect people from across the organization, supporting career development and providing forums for individuals to share experiences on topics they’re passionate about. Together, we are cultivating a connected culture where everyone has the opportunity to learn, grow and succeed together. Job Overview Jensen Hughes are seeking an experienced and commercially minded Principal Fire Engineer to join our growing team in Birmingham. This is a technical leadership role offering the opportunity to deliver complex fire engineering projects across a diverse portfolio of sectors including commercial, residential, healthcare, education, industrial, and infrastructure developments. jobs.title: CDI - Senior Platform Engineer - Paris
jobs.description: Mission Des groupes de premier plan font tourner leur IA sur ce que vous construisez. Infrastructure cloud, plateformes de données, chaînes de delivery, serving de modèles, runtime des agents : ces fondations portent à grande échelle les applications et les agents de nos clients, et vous les concevez et les exploitez. Grâce à ce travail, les équipes produit livrent sans risque, tandis que les coûts, la latence et la sécurité restent sous contrôle. Ce poste est fait pour vous si vos utilisateurs sont d’autres équipes d’ingénierie et si la robustesse d’un système sous charge vous intéresse. Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Platform Engineer.   Activités et responsabilités Les Product Engineers et les AI Engineers déploient sur les plateformes que vous construisez ; leurs besoins se définissent avec eux, et leur accompagnement se poursuit jusqu’en production. Sur une plateforme de données, les fondations vous reviennent : infrastructure, sécurité, réseau, calcul. Ce qui y circule relève des Context & Analytics Engineers. Le travail se mène aussi avec les équipes IT, sécurité et cloud du client, sous le regard desquelles chaque choix d’architecture doit pouvoir se défendre ; le code se relit entre pairs et les nouvelles recrues sont accompagnées. Vos responsabilités : Déployer l’infrastructure cloud en infrastructure as code et conduire les migrations cloud. Construire et exploiter des plateformes de données : entrepôts et lakehouses, orchestration, traitement batch et streaming. Construire des pipelines CI/CD et l’outillage MLOps et LLMOps. Construire le harness des agents : runtime, frameworks d’évaluation, observabilité. Servir les modèles et maîtriser leur coût et leur latence. Poser les

jobs.title: CDI - Senior Context & Analytics Engineer - Paris
jobs.description: Mission Un agent ne vaut que ce que valent les données et les connaissances sur lesquelles il répond. Pipelines, modèles de données, définitions de métriques, droits d’accès : vous créez et gouvernez ce socle, et les applications et les agents de nos clients s’appuient dessus. Quand un analyste ou un agent demande un chiffre, la réponse est celle de l’équipe finance, accompagnée de sa définition et de sa source. Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez que les métiers et les agents puissent se fier aux données, et les utilisent. Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Context & Analytics Engineer.   Activités et responsabilités Avec les équipes métier et les analystes, il s’agit de définir ce que signifie chaque métrique et de vérifier que les données y correspondent. Sur ce socle, les Product Engineers et les AI Engineers construisent applications et agents. Les Platform Engineers exploitent l’infrastructure sur laquelle tournent vos pipelines. Les échanges avec les data owners et les équipes de gouvernance du client, la relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues complètent le quotidien.   Vos responsabilités : Construire des pipelines d’ingestion et des modèles de données, avec dbt par exemple. Mettre en place des contrôles de qualité des données et maintenir le lineage. Construire la couche sémantique et les définitions de métriques, pour que les personnes et les agents utilisent les mêmes chiffres, y compris en text-to-SQL. Définir les règles de gouvernance et les droits d’accès. Construire des pipelines de connaissances pour le RAG : indexation, chunking, métadonnées, permissions. Préparer le contexte exploitable par les agents : métadonnées, définitions,

jobs.title: Founding Tech Lead (GrowthBricks)
jobs.description: Founding Tech Lead (GrowthBricks) Are you a hands-on engineer who loves zero-to-one challenges? Do you want to build systems with real context and memory that do more than reason, use tools, and drive actual business outcomes?  About JetBrains We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale. GrowthBricks is a new project at JetMinds, backed by JetBrains, designed to give GTM teams and AI agents a shared business brain. Business context usually gets fragmented across CRMs, documents, dashboards, and people s heads. GrowthBricks brings that context together so agents and people can make decisions and execute effectively across the sales, marketing, and product stack. About GrowthBricks GrowthBricks is a shared business brain for GTM teams and AI agents. It brings together the context that usually lives across CRM, docs, dashboards, tools, and people’s heads: who we sell to, why customers buy, what matters now, what we tried, and what worked. Agents and people use that context to decide what to do next and execute across the GTM stack. GrowthBricks is a new project at JetMinds, backed by JetBrains. About the role We’re looking for a hands-on Founding Tech Lead to build GrowthBricks from zero. You’ll work directly with the product founder and own the technical side of the product: architecture, core systems, integrations, and the agent layer. The core challenge is turning fragmented, changing business context into reliable memory and agent actions across tools and measuring whether those actions actually drive business outcomes. You’ll write a lot of the early code yourself, make the key technical decisions, and shape the product as we learn what works. What you’ll work on Design the core architecture: business

jobs.title: Graduate Mechanical Engineer (2027 start)
jobs.description: Introduction Are you a curious, creative and technically minded engineer excited by the opportunity to develop innovative solutions? Do you have a passion for  understanding technology, solving complex problems and turning ideas into real-world products? Would you like to work on a diverse range of projects spanning the Industrial, Consumer, Energy, Sustainability, Healthcare and Defence sectors? We are currently recruiting for two specialist areas within our team and welcome applications from candidates with a particular interest in either Fluid Systems & Analysis, or DfX (Design for manufacture) disciplines, including design for manufacture, assembly and product industrialisation   Successful candidates can join us between May and October 2027. There is no deadline for this role, as we recruit on a rolling basis. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.   Your role The Mechanics and Design Department undertakes the development of innovative devices, systems and equipment from concept to manufacture whilst addressing considerable technical and design considerations. We combine user-centred design, innovative mechanical engineering, ‘DfX’ (Design for X, eg. Manufacture, Assembly, Cost etc.) principles , a rigorous systems engineering approach and broad industry experience to form a powerful development team. jobs.title: Software Product Assurance Engineer
jobs.description: Job description Team & Reporting Line: Program Management Team | Reports to Lead Project & Procurement Manager Our Mission   At constellr, we use thermal intelligence from space to understand what is happening on Earth – where, when and at scale. Our satellite constellation delivers high-resolution land surface temperature data, giving governments, defence organisations, commercial operators and global institutions the intelligence they need to monitor change, assess risk and make better-informed decisions. From national security and critical infrastructure to agriculture and climate resilience, constellr turns temperature into actionable intelligence for a changing world. jobs.title: Semiconductor Product / Test Engineer
jobs.description: About Fractile Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts. The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems. We are seeking an experienced Semiconductor Product / Test Engineer to lead the development and deployment of manufacturing test solutions for next-generation AI accelerator devices. This role spans the full silicon lifecycle from first silicon bring-up through high-volume production, with responsibility for defining test strategy, developing ATE test content, debugging complex silicon issues, and optimising yield, coverage, and test cost. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in DFT methodologies, high-speed interface testing, and advanced CMOS manufacturing, and will work closely with design, DFT, packaging, and manufacturing partners to ensure robust, scalable production of high-performance compute silicon. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com , Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development. Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. Position description We are looking for a highly impactful Staff Engineer to join the Identity Squad within our StoreFront department . The Identity squad is the cornerstone of trust and access across Sonar's product ecosystem. The squad is responsible for everything related to authentication (AuthN) and authorization (AuthZ) for all of Sonar’s products. We operate services at scale, handling 1000s of requests per second. As a Staff Engineer, you will be architecting robust, scalable, and highly secure identity solutions that seamlessly bridge our cloud and self-managed offerings. As a Staff engineer you will also play a crucial role in mentoring other engineers, helping them grow their skills and expand their impact. You will partner closely with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, and other Staff/Principal Engineers across the organization to lead the end-to-end delivery of critical identity features. You will take ownership—from initial architecture and design through to implementation and deployment

Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. We are focused on reducing friction and getting the most value from solutions to enhance outcomes. We want to expand our Business Technology landscape to manage more systems in a predictable way that accounts for scalability, resilience, and performance. Join a leading consulting player in the booming space industry and contribute to shaping the next generation of space systems and services. It works with more than 50 customers across developed and emerging space markets and across the space ecosystem, including satellite operators, governmental and international organizations, financial institutions, insurance companies and other space stakeholders. Within the Space Advanced Concepts team , you will work at the intersection of emerging technologies, system architecture and future customer needs. The role combines systems engineering and architecture with the exploration of new technologies, innovative system concepts and New Space approaches, working across traditional space domains and emerging technical fields. Own the relationship to the customer’s technical counterparts during and after the sales process.  Help customers evaluate Firefox Enterprise in areas such as deployment, policy management, identity integration, logging, security controls, and operational fit.
